title: 上海一把手被查：政治局第四位，明年调整前还有谁？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Well, China has opened an investigation into Shanghai Communist Party Chief Chen Jinning for suspected serious violations of law and discipline.
segments.zh: 中国已对上海市委书记陈吉宁涉嫌严重违法违纪展开调查。

segments.en: Now, Chen sits on the country's powerful 24-member Politburo.
segments.zh: 陈吉宁是拥有24名成员的中央政治局委员。

segments.en: It happens in as a potential successor to President Xi Jinping.
segments.zh: 他曾被视为国家领导人的潜在接班人。

segments.en: He's the fourth member of the current Politburo to face a corruption investigation as the party prepares for a reshuffle next year.
segments.zh: 他是本届政治局中第四位面临腐败调查的成员，而党内明年将进行人事调整。

segments.en: And China's downfall could reverberate well beyond China's political leadership.
segments.zh: 这一事件的影响可能远超中国政治领导层。

segments.en: It was a key champion when it came to AI, climate action, and international education.
segments.zh: 他曾在人工智能、气候行动和国际教育领域发挥关键推动作用。

segments.en: Let's bring in blue economics. They're saying now that those areas could now face greater political scrutiny.
segments.zh: 有观点认为，这些领域可能面临更严格的政治审视。

segments.en: I'm pleased to bring in our new senior geoeconomics analyst, Neil Thomas, joining us.
segments.zh: 很高兴邀请到我们的新任高级地缘经济分析师尼尔·托马斯。

segments.en: Neil, it's great to have you on the program, obviously.
But this has certainly been quite an interesting headline when it comes to Chen Jinning.
segments.zh: 但陈吉宁的消息确实是一个相当引人关注的新闻。

segments.en: First and foremost, tell us a bit more about the significance of this investigation and tell us a bit more about who Chen Jinning is.
segments.zh: 首先，请谈谈这次调查的重要性，并介绍一下陈吉宁是谁。

segments.en: Thanks for having me, Evonne. It's great to be here. Great to be at Bloomberg.
segments.zh: 谢谢邀请，Evonne。很高兴来到这里，很高兴来到彭博。

segments.en: This investigation is significant because up until yesterday, Chen Jinning was one of the rising stars of Chinese politics.
segments.zh: 这次调查意义重大，因为直到昨天，陈吉宁还是中国政坛冉冉升起的新星之一。

segments.en: He had come through the Chianghua University System.
He was a climate scientist. And he became president of Chianghua.
segments.zh: 他曾是气候科学家，后来成为清华大学校长。

segments.en: He was a minister of environment.
